verdict.rationale: Stagehand is a code SDK (TypeScript, Python, Go) whose own primitives, act(), extract(), observe() and page methods, are composed step by step into automations. Cached and deterministic-script conversion makes those runs repeatable, and agent fallbacks handle multi-step branching. However, the evidence never documents loops, conditionals or parameterization as a workflow feature; that control flow would come only from the host language. missing for 10: documented loop/conditional/parameterized workflow constructs or examples, independent hands-on evidence of composing repeatable multi-step workflows.
